verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own call-handling capability: User Call Handling, state-based rules, call handling configurations and call forwarding targets. It also offers call queues with routing, plus voicemail, which together suggest unanswered calls can be forwarded to voicemail or another number. However, the evidence never explicitly describes ringing a group sequentially versus simultaneously, or overflow behavior for no-answer calls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sequential vs. simultaneous group ring modes, explicit no-answer overflow to voicemail or an external number, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
